chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha', who said:
I heard Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام saying:

A man, during the time of Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام, insulted the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. So he was brought to the governor of al-Madinah, and he gathered the people. Then Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام entered upon him while he had only recently recovered from illness, and he had a cloak upon him. So he seated him at the head of the assembly, sought his permission to recline, and said to them, “What do you think?” 'Abd Allah ibn al-Hasan, al-Hasan ibn Zayd, and others said to him, “We think that his tongue should be cut off.” Then the governor turned to Rabi'at al-Ra'y and his companions and said, “What do you think?” He said, “He should be disciplined.” Then Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said to him, “Glory be to Allah! So there is no difference between the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and his companions?”

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whose sanctity is central in the report
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ: an expression of astonishment and glorification of Allah
key_terms.عَامِلِ الْمَدِينَةِ: the governor or official authority of al-Madinah
key_terms.فَرْقٌ: distinction or difference in legal or moral standing
key_terms.يُؤَدَّبُ: that he should be disciplined or punished
key_terms.يُقْطَعَ لِسَانُهُ: that his tongue should be cut off

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith indicate about the gravity of insulting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a case in which a man insulted the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during the time of Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام and was brought before the governor of al-Madinah. The report centers on the consultation over the legal response and the objection of Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام to treating insult against the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله the same as insult against ordinary companions.
